mainEntity.name: What is a good ROAS for a D2C brand in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no universal number. A good ROAS is any figure above your break-even ROAS, which depends on your COGS, shipping, gateway fees and RTO rate. Brands with 30% COGS and low returns can be profitable at 2.2x, while brands with 55% COGS and 25% RTO may need 4.5x or more.

mainEntity.name: Does increasing ad spend improve ROAS?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Spend determines how many orders you get, not how efficiently you get them. ROAS is set by your CPM, your AOV and the five conversion rates between an impression and a paid order. Doubling spend roughly doubles orders at the same ROAS.

mainEntity.name: Which funnel step should I fix first?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually the one furthest from the benchmark, weighted by traffic volume. Landing-page-to-cart is typically the most expensive step to get wrong because every visitor has already been paid for by that point.
